fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 4th Energy Store (ES) 4th Control Electronics Unit (PU-CE) Power Unit element and the control electronics unit were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during Parc Ferme.

penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: As the abovementioned parts were replaced in breach of parc ferme conditions without permission, the relevant driver must start from the Pit Lane per Article B3.5.3b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
